title: OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmarks measured intrasentence and intersentence stereotypical bias related to religion, evaluating the models' preference for stereotypical expressions.
findings: On the CrowS-Pairs benchmark, the OPT-175B model exhibited less stereotypical bias related to religion compared to GPT-3 (Davinci), being the only category where it performed better. On the StereoSet benchmark, OPT-175B also outperformed Davinci in the religion category on the Stereotype Score (SS) and Idealized Context Association Test (ICAT) metrics.
